edges_between.note: The number of ORDERED pairs (a, b) with a in A, b in B and a -- b, for arbitrary, possibly overlapping A and B: an edge inside A :&: B is counted in both orientations. Symmetric in A and B; with the non-edge count it partitions A x B; on disjoint sets it is the number of edges of E(G) meeting both sets (edges_between_cross). K_n: |A||B| - |A :&: B|; K_2 taken whole: 2.

nonedges_between.note: The number of ORDERED pairs (a, b) with a in A, b in B and ~~ (a -- b), including the diagonal pair (x, x) of each x in A :&: B; on disjoint sets it agrees with the number of complement edges between them (nonedges_between_compl); with overlap that reading can fail (nonedges_between_compl_overlap). K_n: |A :&: B|.
